method: Independent source-only review of the frozen uncommitted candidate; no tests, builds, browser activity, Git mutation, or remote operation.

A_requirement_alignment.verdict: Core pre-publication gate addressed in source; one exclusion-notice gap remains.

original_findings.title: ship.sh pushes unvalidated main
original_findings.evidence: ship.sh:16-29 execs release.sh directly and no longer calls sync-main.py.

original_findings.title: Conflicts silently omit local behavior
original_findings.evidence: release.sh:252-265 stops on merge-tree conflict before publication; ship.sh no longer uses sync-main.py's held-conflict path.

original_findings.title: Main and tag published separately
original_findings.evidence: release.sh:376-421 discovers remote tags, validates the candidate, publishes main and tag through git push --atomic, and rebuilds after a branch or tag race.

original_findings.title: Dirty checkout work silently omitted
original_findings.evidence: release.sh:71-77 reports excluded dirty paths, but the successful path prints them at :482, after publication at :406-410.
original_findings.action: Announce excluded paths before publication so the operator can see what will be omitted.

A_requirement_alignment.contract_evidence: release.sh:383-403 regenerates, bumps, checks, and builds both ZIPs from the candidate SHA before the atomic push. :411-419 restarts after a race. :230-241 exits dry-run before build or push. ship.sh passes --no-push through.
A_requirement_alignment.fixture_safety: scripts/test-release-ship-path.sh:18-36 creates a temporary bare origin and local clones; :49-90 stubs node and pnpm. No real origin is configured in the fixture. It was not executed in this review.

B_code_quality.verdict: Ordinary snapshot and ZIP promotion failures are handled; concurrency and late cleanup remain unsafe.

original_findings.title: Snapshot Git setup failure nonfatal
original_findings.evidence: release.sh:176-190 returns failure on Git setup or prepare failure; callers at :270 and :394-395 stop before publication.

original_findings.title: Local ZIP promotion not pairwise atomic
original_findings.evidence: release.sh:429-471 stages, compares, backs up, and restores both ZIPs on install or unpacked promotion failure; restore command failures are not checked.

original_findings.title: Fixture does not force all gates
original_findings.evidence: Fixture now forces generation, unit tests, build, Store check, a failed second candidate after branch race, tag collision, and merge conflict. It does not force each mandatory check, ZIP rollback, or unpacked/receipt failure. Aggregate rerun counts at :200-203 include earlier attempts.

new_findings.title: Live release lock stolen after 60 seconds
new_findings.evidence: release.sh:203-215 removes a lock held by a live PID after 60 seconds; checks and builds can run longer. Two release processes could then interleave publication and local artifact promotion.
new_findings.action: Wait for or refuse a live lock owner; never take over a live release.

new_findings.title: Unpacked cleanup failure leaves inconsistent artifacts
new_findings.evidence: scripts/sync-unpacked-release.mjs:168-175 writes the new receipt before backup deletion at :185-189, outside the rollback catch. If deletion throws, release.sh:463-470 restores only ZIPs and claims prior artifacts were restored while new unpacked bundles and receipt can remain.
new_findings.action: Make cleanup failure separately recoverable and report the actual installed state.

new_findings.title: Failed ZIP restore can lose its backup
new_findings.evidence: release.sh:441-470 does not check restore_output_zips rm/mv results; the EXIT trap at :159-164 deletes the staging directory containing a backup that failed to move home.
new_findings.action: Check each restore, preserve failed backups, and report their recovery path.

B_code_quality.runtime_status: Root-owned admitted green fixture run and real build/UI verification pending; this is source review, not runtime pass.
